For decades now, there have existed other Latinate conlangs, different projects. And in the future, some hope for others. But it has been the Green Dream, Esperanto, that has succeeded for more than a century. Reforms attempted upon Esperanto have met with failure over the decades because genuine Esperanto has an artistic balance with which one cannot tamper. Esperanto remains enduring. Amongst the Blues, my vote is still Interlingua. More people should give it a chance. Esperanto's accents give a charm to the language that perhaps boosted its survival over the years. statements.english: In the morning of the 27th of February of 2022, on my way out of my Lulu Island house, I saw my neighbours the redhead Rochelle of Russian-Mennonite ancestry and the grey-haired moustached Al from the Anglophone section of Montreal; he was from many generations of Canadians. He said that he did not know French, when he lived in Montreal. I ate a slice of pesto cheese pizza at the pizzeria. The vendor was from Mumbai. Through the window, I could see a young brown-blond-haired man in a dark-grey hooded jacket and blue shorts, which made him look like a "big boy." At the cafe, there was an under-age-30 crowd of ten outside, of whom one looked like a handsome Jew. Inside was a table of five or six over-age-30 people, of whom one was a handsome tomboy in a dark-green jacket and army-green pants. I drank my iced black tea. Heading out of the cafe, I saw the "big boy" smoking in the wooded park. I took the long route home, through the grassy school field littered with goose poop, the northern snowcapped mountains obscured by clouds, an Animistic-Buddhistic view seemingly of a different planet. Near my house, parked in a truck were Olivia and Daniel. Olivia was studying Biochemistry. In the back seat of the truck was a fully black German Shepherd.

statements.chinese: 2025 年 5 月 14 日,天空多雲,間或有藍色空間。我兩次走到聖奧爾本斯路上的羅馬天主教堂,一次在早上,一次在下午,這是我今年春天第 12 次和第 13 次。早上,穿著制服的小男孩和小女孩們在寬敞的禮拜堂裡懺悔。他們來自不同的種族。神父在告解室和一個學生交談。在崇拜小堂,我注意到左前方有一盆漂亮的蘭花。下午,寬敞的禮拜堂幾乎空無一人,我通常更喜歡這種狀態。路邊有個穿著白色背心的英俊肌肉男在慢跑。那棵開著紫色花朵的大樹看起來像一棵皇后樹,一棵泡桐,因為它有著大大的心形葉子。它讓我想起開著紫色花朵的藍花楹,讓我對南美洲充滿了懷念。在提姆霍頓斯咖啡館,我早上享用了香腸馬鈴薯炒蛋和一杯燕麥奶伯爵茶,下午又喝了一杯經典冰檸檬水。這一天我都在散步。在家,我學習了一些邏輯語和世界語。我有很多世界語書籍。我的融合主義傾向是萬物有靈論和佛教。
statements.english: This 14th of May of 2025 is cloudy skies interspersed with blue spaces. I walked to the Roman Catholic church on St. Albans Road twice, once in the morning and again in the afternoon, my 12th and 13th times this spring. In the morning was confession for the little boys and girls in uniform. They were of different races, in the big worship hall. The priest was in the confession booth talking to a student. At the Adoration Chapel, I noticed a nice pot of orchids on the front left. In the afternoon, the big worship hall was mostly empty, a condition which I usually prefer. At the road was a handsome muscle man in white tank top jogging. The big purple-bloom tree seems like an Empress Tree, a Paulownia, because of the big heart-shaped leaves. Reminiscent of Jacaranda with its purple blooming, it's saudade for me about South America. At Tim Hortons café, I enjoyed Scrambled Eggs with Sausage and Potatoes and an Earl Grey Tea with oat milk in the morning, and an Iced Classic Lemonade in the afternoon. The day was full of walking. At home, I study bits of Lojban and Esperanto. I have many books in Esperanto. I tend towards Animism-Buddhism in my Syncretism.

statements.chinese: 今天是 2013 年 9 月 4 日。有人說世界語就像西班牙語或義大利語。其實,這些語言就像杏仁牛軋糖或巧克力蛋糕一樣甜美。世界語的味道更微妙,就像豆腐、蘿蔔或蠔油蒸蔬菜的味道。世界語比國際語、西班牙語、義大利語、法語或葡萄牙語更適合中部地區的思維。它確實更適合東方人的思維。
statements.english: It is the 4th of September of 2013. Some say that Esperanto is like Spanish or Italian. Actually, these latter languages are sweet like almond nougat or chocolate cake. Esperanto has a more subtle taste like tofu, radish, or steamed vegetables with oyster sauce. Esperanto suits the Centralian mind better than does Interlingua, Spanish, Italian, French, or Portuguese. It really is more suitable for an Eastern mind.

statements.chinese: 2015 年 4 月 14 日,我步行前往列治文公共市場,先是爬上了外面的階梯。市場內部寬敞的中庭式建築,讓我感覺彷彿置身於叢林之中。我當時已經有點餓了,便小跑到小吃攤「瓦船長」那裡,點了一份麵和一杯熱茶。麵裡有魷魚、魚和豆腐。我吃著吃著,一位穿著紫色 T 恤的英俊原住民男子從我身邊走過。接著,一位身材魁梧、相貌英俊的猶太人也走了過來。幾分鐘後,我開始覺得口渴,於是在「QQ 珍珠奶茶與咖啡」買了一杯冰鎮薄荷珍珠綠茶。我坐在階梯旁慢慢品嚐。附近坐著一家三口吃東西,男人是黑人,女人是東亞人,小孩是混血兒。我喝珍珠奶茶上癮,於是在「花生家」又買了一杯。這次是冰鎮青蘋果珍珠綠茶,味道好極了。我搭扶梯下樓。去洗手間的路上,我注意到一個大水族箱,裡面養著大概是體型巨大的阿拉斯加紅帝王蟹,蟹腿上長滿了藤壺。不知怎的,牠們讓我想起了外星生物。在書店裡,我買了一本圖文並茂的綠色植物學書籍,上面用的是漢字。一個月前我把它放在一個箱子上,現在還在那裡。這本書 14 塊錢。我搭扶梯上樓。我對珍珠奶茶還是有癮,於是用剩下的零錢買了一杯冰荔枝珍珠綠茶。味道好極了,裡面甚至還有白色的荔枝果肉。
statements.english: On the 14th of April of 2015, I walk to the Richmond Public Market, I first climbing the stairs outside. Inside, the wide atrium-like building is like a garden in a jungle surrounding, I imagine. Already quite hungry, I trot to Captain Wa, the food vendor, to get noodles with squid, fish, and tofu, as well as hot tea. As I eat, a handsome First Nations man in a purple T-shirt walks by. Then a handsome, stocky Jewish fellow walks by. A few minutes later, I begin to thirst, so I get a cold Mint Bubble Green Tea at the vendor QQ Bubble Tea and Coffee. I sit by the stairs to sip. A threesome family sits eating nearby, the man being black, the woman being Oriental, and the child being a hybrid. Addicted to Bubble Tea, I get another one, this time at Peanut's. It is a cold Green Apple Bubble Green Tea. It is delicious. I take the escalator down. On my way to the washroom, I notice a big aquarium full of probably giant red Alaskan king crabs with barnacles on their legs. They remind me of extraterrestrials, somehow. At the bookstore, I buy a heavily illustrated green botany book in sinograms. I left it on top of a box a month ago and it is still there. It is $14. I take the escalator up. Addicted to Bubble Tea, I spend my remaining coins on a cold Lychee Bubble Green Tea. It is delicious with even bits of white lychee flesh.

statements.english: South Africa’s nearly 700,000 high-schoolers had been eagerly awaiting this week’s announcement of their matriculation exam grades—scores used by universities to determine which program of study a student is admitted to.

statements.chinese: 老師開始拿萊拉的頭猛擊黑板。
statements.english: The teacher started hitting Layla's head against the blackboard.

statements.chinese: 黑板上寫滿了數學方程式,老師正用一把砍刀當教鞭講解。黑板上方寫著一句格言,大概是為了激勵學生:「學習並遵循胡志明主席的教誨,我們的心靈更加光明!」
statements.english: A blackboard had been covered with math equations, which the teacher was explaining, using a machete as a pointer. Above the blackboard was a motto, probably intended to be inspirational: "Studying and following Uncle Ho's words, our hearts are brighter!"

statements.chinese: 老師,黑板上的函數不是指數函數,是三角函數。
statements.english: Hey, sir, the function on the blackboard is not exponential, but trigonometric.
What did she write on the blackboard?

courses.title: 第 042 课
courses.description: 全量中英直译语料 · 第 74101–74200 句

statements.english: The blackboard needs erasing.

statements.chinese: 亨特教授在講課時更喜歡盯著黑板看,而不是看學生。
statements.english: In his lectures, Professor Hunter prefers to study the blackboard rather than look at his students.

statements.chinese: 湯姆在黑板上寫了些什麼。
statements.english: Tom wrote something on the blackboard.
Can you see the blackboard?

statements.chinese: 湯姆在黑板上寫了什麼?
statements.english: What did Tom write on the blackboard?

statements.chinese: 安妮,妳下午剩下的時間就站在黑板前的平台上。
statements.english: Anne, go and stand on the platform in front of the blackboard for the rest of the afternoon.

statements.chinese: 拿起這支粉筆,在黑板上寫字。
statements.english: Take this piece of chalk and write on the blackboard.

statements.chinese: 他組織了一場關於時事的課堂辯論。
statements.english: He organized a classroom debate on current events.
He was trapped inside the classroom.
Take off your caps in the classroom!

statements.chinese: 齊里跑出教室時撞到了人,摔倒在地。
statements.english: As Ziri ran out of the classroom, he bumped into someone and fell to the floor.

statements.chinese: 在座各位有人聽過諾曼芬克爾斯坦嗎?
statements.english: Has anyone here in the classroom heard about Norman Finkelstein?

statements.chinese: 教室裡只剩下幾個學生了。
statements.english: There were only a few pupils left in the classroom.
The classroom is clean.

statements.chinese: 我希望我們的教室有冷氣。
statements.english: I wish our classroom were air-conditioned.

statements.chinese: 老師要求我們每天都打掃教室。
statements.english: The teacher tells us to clean our classroom every day.

statements.chinese: 第一個被我看到在打遊戲、聊 QQ,或在開心網看文章的人,會被我請出去。這裡是教室,不是網咖。
statements.english: The first person that I see playing a video game, chatting on QQ, or reading articles on Kaixin, is going to be shown the door. This is a classroom, not a cybercafé.

statements.chinese: 草莓樹是該地區常見的景觀植物。
statements.english: The strawberry tree is a commonly used landscape plant in this area.

statements.chinese: 蟬破土而出後,會蛻皮,等待身體乾燥變硬,然後飛到樹頂覓食和尋找配偶,牠們通過發出響亮的蟬鳴來尋找配偶。
statements.english: Once out of the ground, the cicadas molt and wait for their bodies to dry and harden, then they fly to the tops of trees where they feed and look for a mate, which they do by making a loud buzz.

statements.chinese: 西班牙人用草莓樹的果實釀造一種白蘭地。
statements.english: The Spanish make a type of brandy with the fruits of the strawberry tree.

statements.chinese: 湯姆在兩棵樹之間拉起了一條晾衣繩。
statements.english: Tom strung a clothesline between the two trees.

statements.chinese: 他寫過關於植物和樹木的文章。
statements.english: He wrote about plants and trees.

statements.chinese: 一棵倒下的樹擋住了路。
statements.english: A fallen tree blocked the road.

statements.chinese: 如果非要我當你的丈夫,我寧願上吊死在第一棵樹上。
statements.english: If I had to be your husband, I'd rather hang myself on the first tree.

statements.chinese: 如果樹木會說話,他們會告訴我們什麼?
statements.english: If trees could talk, what would they tell us?

statements.chinese: 成熟的枇杷很容易從樹上摘下來。
statements.english: Ripe medlars come away easily from the tree.
Did you trim the apple trees?

statements.chinese: 他望向房子後面的那棵松樹。
statements.english: He looked at the pine tree behind the house.

statements.chinese: 松木是一種富含樹脂的木材。
statements.english: Pine is a resinous wood.

statements.chinese: 四面八方都是巍峨的雪峰,將他們包圍起來,彼此交錯,一直延伸到遙遠的地平線。兩側的岩岸陡峭無比,落葉松和松樹彷彿懸在他們頭頂,只需一陣風就能轟然落下。
statements.english: In every direction the great snow-capped peaks hemmed them in, peeping over each other's shoulders to the far horizon. So steep were the rocky banks on either side of them that the larch and the pine seemed to be suspended over their heads, and to need only a gust of wind to come hurtling down upon them.
I'm pining for him.
I love pine woods.

statements.chinese: 「你知道你剛才折斷的是什麼樹嗎?」我回答偵探:「不知道。」偵探透過敞開的門往裡面看,喊道:「喂,你知道他剛才折斷的是什麼樹嗎?」一個年輕女子的聲音說:「嗯,看起來像是紫杉。」偵探坐直身子後,又問了我一遍:「你知道你剛才折斷的是什麼樹嗎?」
statements.english: "Do you know what kind of tree you just broke?" "No, I don't," I answered the detective. While looking through the open door, the detective shouted, "Hey, do you know what kind of tree he just broke?" "Um, looks like it's a yew plum pine," said the voice of a young woman. After straightening himself in his seat, the detective asked me one more time: "Do you know what kind of tree you just broke?"

statements.chinese: 松科樹木的木材因其優良的品質,在建築和家具製造領域備受推崇。
statements.english: The wood of trees in the pine family is much prized for construction and furniture making.

statements.chinese: 湯姆在森林裡撿了一些松果。
statements.english: Tom collected some pine cones in the forest.

statements.chinese: 她懷念自己的青春歲月。
statements.english: She pines for the days of her youth.

statements.chinese: 越過松林,遠處有一座小花園。那裡青草長得又長又茂盛,鐵杉花像潔白的星星一樣閃耀,夜鶯整夜唱歌。牠整夜歌唱,冰冷的月光俯瞰著牠,紫杉樹張開巨大的枝幹,庇護著沉睡的人們。
statements.english: Far away beyond the pine-woods, there is a little garden. There the grass grows long and deep, there are the great white stars of the hemlock flower, there the nightingale sings all night long. All night long he sings, and the cold crystal moon looks down, and the yew-tree spreads out its giant arms over the sleepers.

statements.chinese: 楓樹美麗的紅葉從枝頭飄落,在風中翩翩起舞。
statements.english: The beautiful red leaves of the maple become detached from the branches and are dancing in the wind.

statements.chinese: 桌上擺放著一瓶被霜凍漂白的蕨類植物和紅寶石色的楓葉。
statements.english: A vase of frost-bleached ferns and ruby-red maple leaves adorned the table.
Could you pass me the maple syrup?

statements.chinese: 植物園內種植了 450 多株杜鵑花,還有楓樹、美國榆樹和鐵杉等樹木,用於景觀美化。
statements.english: The arboretum includes more than 450 azaleas for landscaping, but also trees like maples, American elms, and hemlocks.

statements.chinese: 我們早餐吃了煎餅和楓糖漿。
statements.english: We ate pancakes and maple syrup for breakfast.

statements.chinese: 十月的綠山牆農舍很美。山谷裡的白樺樹變得金燦燦的,像陽光一樣;果園後面的楓樹變成了深紅色;小路兩旁的野櫻桃樹呈現出最可愛的深紅色和古銅綠色。
statements.english: October was a beautiful month at Green Gables, when the birches in the hollow turned as golden as sunshine and the maples behind the orchard were royal crimson and the wild cherry trees along the lane put on the loveliest shades of dark red and bronzy green.
What is this, maple?
That's a maple.

statements.chinese: 她與強大的祖琳女王有著密切的血緣關係,她的家在一棵枝繁葉茂的橡樹蔭下。
statements.english: She was closely related to the mighty Queen Zurline, and her home was beneath the shade of a widespreading oak.

statements.chinese: 一粒小小的橡實可以長成一棵高大的橡樹。
statements.english: From a small acorn grows a tall oak tree.
It's an oak tree.
The oak tree was no longer there.

statements.chinese: 齊裡看到橡樹上有一個很大的爪痕。
statements.english: Ziri saw a large claw mark on the oak tree.

statements.chinese: 這位是奧克教授,他是這項實驗的負責人。
statements.english: This is Professor Oak, the director of this experiment.

statements.chinese: 我們突然向下望去,只見一個杯狀的窪地,上麵點綴著矮小的橡樹和被多年風暴肆虐扭曲變形的蕨類植物。兩座高聳狹窄的塔樓聳立在樹梢之上。車夫用鞭子指著前方。他說:「巴斯克維爾莊園。」
statements.english: Suddenly we looked down into a cup-like depression, patched with stunted oaks and furs which had been twisted and bent by the fury of years of storm. Two high, narrow towers rose over the trees. The driver pointed with his whip. “Baskerville Hall,” said he.

statements.chinese: 他們並排坐在橡樹下,嚐到了接吻的滋味後,便無法停止彼此的愛意。
statements.english: They were seated side by side under an oak, and, having once tasted of the pleasure of kissing, were unable to cease their endearments.

statements.chinese: 刮風的時候,老橡樹的葉子會沙沙作響,樹枝會發出嘎吱聲。
statements.english: When it's windy, the leaves of the old oak rustle and its branches creak.

statements.chinese: 在北方的原始部落中,也存在著一種更野蠻的慶祝形式:他們點燃巨大的木柴,以紀念奧丁和托爾,並向祂們獻祭人和牲畜。德魯伊王子隨後用金色鐮刀從神聖的橡樹上割下槲寄生。
statements.english: A more barbarous form of these rejoicings took place among the rude peoples of the north where great blocks of wood blazed in honor of Odin and Thor, and sacrifices of men and cattle were made to them. Mistletoe was cut then from the sacred oaks with a golden sickle by the Prince of the Druids.

statements.chinese: 他們用紅雪松製作了巨大、怪誕卻又美麗的木桿。
statements.english: They made huge, grotesque, yet beautiful poles of red cedar.

statements.chinese: 那裡以前有一棵高大的雪松樹。
statements.english: There used to be a large cedar tree there.

statements.chinese: 閣樓是一個狹長的低矮房間,光線昏暗,瀰漫著雪松的香氣。
statements.english: The attic was a long, low-ceilinged room, dark and fragrant with the odor of the cedar.

statements.chinese: 今天的雪松數量非常高,所以我可能得打電話給單位,說我病得太厲害不能去上班了。
statements.english: The cedar count today is really high, so I might have to call work and tell them I'm too sick to go in.
Where do cedars grow?

statements.chinese: 雪松的氣味可以驅趕飛蛾。
statements.english: The scent of cedar repels moths.

statements.chinese: 如果雪松著火了,從牆裡長出來的牛膝草會說什麼呢?
statements.english: If the cedars have caught fire, what will the hyssops that grow out of the wall say?

statements.chinese: 稀疏、低矮、枝葉稀疏的雪松被數量更多、顏色更深、更綠、更茂密的雪松所取代,這些雪松又被高大、枝繁葉茂、結滿綠色漿果的樹木所取代。
statements.english: Scant, low, scraggy cedars gave place to more numerous, darker, greener, bushier ones, and these to high, full-foliaged, green-berried trees.

statements.chinese: 卡羅爾威克和她的丈夫擁有美國人都夢想的一小塊土地,位於華盛頓州西雅圖東南部的喀斯喀特山麓邊緣,佔地 12 公頃。從她家門口步行不遠,穿過一些牧場和一座破舊的穀倉,就能到達覆蓋她土地約三分之一的冷杉和雪松林。
statements.english: Carol Wick and her husband own a small slice of the American dream, 12 hectares at the edge of the Cascade foothills, southeast of Seattle, Washington. A short walk from her doorstop, past some pastures and a dilapidated barn, is the fir and cedar forest that covers about one-third of her property.

statements.chinese: 沿著這條路往前走,靠近俄克拉荷馬州阿卡迪亞小鎮,轉過一個彎,你會看到一座大穀倉,穀倉是圓形的,外牆是鮮紅色的,屋頂是綠色的雪松木瓦,形狀像個雞蛋。據說這是 66 號公路上最多人拍照的景點。
statements.english: Just down the road, near the little town of Arcadia, Oklahoma, you come around a bend and spy a big barn - a round one, bright red with a green, egg-shaped cedar-shingle roof. It's said this is the most-photographed spot on all of Route 66.

statements.chinese: 我真希望湯姆能來聽我的演唱會。
statements.english: I wish Tom could've come to my concert.

statements.chinese: 有不少人去看了演唱會。
statements.english: Quite a few people went to the concert.

statements.chinese: 我絕對不會錯過你的演唱會。
statements.english: I wouldn't miss your concert for the world.

statements.chinese: 你一直待到演唱會結束嗎?
statements.english: Did you stay till the end of the concert?

statements.chinese: 我來幫你弄張演唱會門票吧。
statements.english: Let me get you a ticket to the concert.

statements.chinese: 我很期待去看這場音樂會。
statements.english: I'm looking forward to going to the concert.

statements.chinese: 我送了我女兒一張音樂會門票作為生日禮物。
statements.english: I gave my daughter an entry ticket to the concert for her birthday.

statements.chinese: 拉欽舉辦了一場音樂會,慶祝 5 月 28 日的獨立紀念日。
statements.english: Lachin hosted concert marking May 28 – Independence Day.
The concert was a success.

statements.chinese: 我生病了,所以沒能去看演唱會。
statements.english: I was sick, so I couldn't go to the concert.

statements.chinese: 湯姆是波士頓的爵士歌手。
statements.english: Tom is a jazz singer in Boston.

statements.chinese: 湯姆說你比瑪莉唱得好。
statements.english: Tom said that you're a better singer than Mary.

statements.chinese: 這則分類廣告招募女歌手組成無伴奏合唱團。
statements.english: The classified ad wanted female singers to form an a cappella group.

statements.chinese: 你最喜歡的加拿大歌手是誰?
statements.english: Who is your favorite Canadian singer?

statements.chinese: 瑪莉發現湯姆其實是一位很有才華的歌手。
statements.english: Mary discovered that Tom was secretly a talented singer.

statements.chinese: 我知道湯姆唱歌很好聽,但我認為瑪麗唱得更好。
statements.english: I know Tom is a good singer, but I think Mary is better.
Who's the best singer in your family?

statements.chinese: 這位歌手擁有一副好嗓子,但我認為他不會受到年輕人的喜愛。
statements.english: The singer has a good opera voice, but I don't think he'll catch on with young people.
She's my favorite singer.

statements.chinese: 接吻時最該注意的是什麼?歌手馬克斯拉貝回答了這個重要的問題。
statements.english: What must one keep in mind during a kiss, above all else? The singer Max Raabe answers this important question.

statements.chinese: 幾天之內,德軍便在波蘭境內展開了大規模攻擊。
statements.english: Within days, German forces fanned out across Poland.

statements.chinese: 如果你是中國文化愛好者,或許可以讀《古漢語聲調的起源》這篇文章。
statements.english: If you are a China fan, maybe read the article "Origins of Tones in Old Chinese."
Could you turn that fan off?
Tom is an opera fan.
I'm not a big fan of Tom's.

statements.chinese: 日本文化愛好者可能會喜歡《早期古日文中的作格與裸名詞》這篇文章。
statements.english: Japan fans may like the article "Ergativity and Bare Nominals in Early Old Japanese."

statements.chinese: 貝內迪托與排隊的粉絲們擊掌。
statements.english: Benedito gave out high fives to fans in the queue.
Sami is a SpongeBob fan.

statements.chinese: 他通常不會和粉絲互動。
statements.english: He doesn't usually get involved with his fan.

statements.chinese: 我不喜歡突如其來的拜訪。
statements.english: I'm not a fan of surprise visits.

statements.chinese: 柏柏旗幟由三條橫條組成:上半部為藍色,象徵地中海;下半部為綠色,象徵塔馬茲加平原;下半部為黃色,象徵沙漠。在這些條紋之上疊加著字母「阿札 (雅茲) ⵥ」,象徵著提非納格文字 (伊馬齊根人的古老文字),紅色代表鮮血和自由。
statements.english: The Berber flag has an upper band of blue like the Mediterranean Sea, then a green band like the plains of Tamazgha, and finally a yellow band representing the desert. Upon these stripes is superimposed the letter Aza (yaz) ⵥ, symbolizing the tifinagh, ancient writing of Imazighen, in red, representing blood and freedom.

statements.chinese: 光是聽那個樂團的歌就會染病。
statements.english: I got a disease from listening to that band.

statements.chinese: 我們去聽聽湯姆的樂團演奏吧。
statements.english: Let's go and listen to Tom's band.

statements.chinese: 很難找到一位沒有在其他樂團工作的優秀主唱。
statements.english: It'll be hard to find a good vocalist who isn't already working with another band.

statements.chinese: 樂團現在將為大家演奏他們的最新歌曲。開始吧,夥計們!
statements.english: The band will play their latest song for you now. Take it away, guys!

courses.title: 第 043 课
courses.description: 全量中英直译语料 · 第 74201–74300 句

statements.chinese: 我非常樂意和你們樂團一起唱歌。
statements.english: I would love to sing with your band.

statements.chinese: 武士團夥來來往往,忙於家族世仇;但絕大多數人繼續耕作土地,只要他們不干涉自己村莊社區的獨立,人們就對那些妄圖統治他們的人漠不關心。
statements.english: The warrior bands came and went, prosecuting their family feuds; but the great mass continued to till the soil, taking but little notice of their would-be rulers, so long as they did not interfere with the independence of their village communities.

statements.chinese: 將血壓帶 (或止血帶) 套在手臂上,逐漸增加壓力,直到前臂發紺,橈動脈搏動幾乎消失。
statements.english: A blood-pressure band, or tourniquet, is placed about the arm, and the pressure increased until the forearm becomes cyanosed and the radial pulse is almost obliterated.

statements.chinese: 我在一支迷幻搖滾樂團裡彈吉他。
statements.english: I play guitar in a psychedelic rock band.

statements.chinese: 樂隊正在進行音響測試。
statements.english: The band is now doing a sound check.

statements.chinese: 您可以跳過認證過程的第三階段,直接進入第六階段。
statements.english: You can skip stage three of the certification process and advance immediately to stage six.

statements.chinese: 體育場內已搭建起舞台。
statements.english: A stage has been set up in the stadium.
Ziri was called onto the stage.

statements.chinese: 人生如夢,如影隨形,像個蹩腳的演員,在舞台上虛張聲勢、矯揉造作一小時,然後便銷聲匿跡。人生如白痴講的故事,喧囂吵雜,卻毫無意義。
statements.english: Life's but a walking shadow, a poor player that struts and frets his hour upon the stage, and then is heard no more. It is a tale told by an idiot, full of sound and fury, signifying nothing.

statements.chinese: 薩米為我們重現了他在舞台上的表演。
statements.english: Sami reenacted for us what he did on stage.

statements.chinese: 有些音樂家會在舞台上喝酒。
statements.english: Some musicians drink on stage.

statements.chinese: 普丁將成為國際舞台上的棄兒。
statements.english: Putin will be a pariah on the international stage.

statements.chinese: 這場四分之一決賽的勝者將晉級半決賽。
statements.english: The winner of this quarter-final match will advance to the semi-final stage.

statements.chinese: 羅德里戈的賽車在比賽的第四階段 (也是最後一個階段) 發生撞車事故。
statements.english: Rodrigo’s car crashed in the fourth and last stage of the race.

statements.chinese: 我們在敵後集結區伏擊了他們數百台新型 J-37 機器人,並透過派出一群攜帶炸藥的綿羊穿過他們的營地,將它們全部摧毀。
statements.english: We ambushed several hundred of their new J-37 robots behind enemy lines in a staging area and we destroyed them all by sending a herd of explosive laden sheep through their encampment.

statements.chinese: 我們下個月要去愛沙尼亞旅行。
statements.english: We're going to travel to Estonia next month.

statements.chinese: 他們下個月一定會去度假。
statements.english: Certainly they will go on holiday next month.

statements.chinese: 母親每個月給妹妹兩千日元。
statements.english: Mother gives my sister two thousand yen every month.

statements.chinese: 你曾經一個月賺過 3 萬美元以上嗎?
statements.english: Have you ever made more than $30,000 in one month?

statements.chinese: 雅尼在阿爾及爾待了四個月。
statements.english: Yanni was in Algiers for four months.

statements.chinese: 婚禮還有不到三個月就要舉行了。
statements.english: The wedding is less than three months away.
I expected you to stay three months.
He will go there next month.

statements.chinese: 齊里在那房子裡只住了幾個月。
statements.english: Ziri only lived in that house for a few months.

statements.chinese: 你一個月做幾次這種事?
statements.english: How many times a month do you do that?

statements.chinese: 雅尼的生日是 4 月 4 日。
statements.english: Yanni's birthday is April 4th.

statements.chinese: 他於四月訪問了阿爾及利亞。
statements.english: He came to visit Algeria in April.

statements.chinese: 日本的新學年從四月開始。
statements.english: In Japan a new school year starts in April.

statements.chinese: 齊里的故事發生在四月。
statements.english: Ziri's story took place in April.

statements.chinese: 我們四月要搬回阿爾及爾。
statements.english: We were moving back to Algiers in April.

statements.chinese: 我將於四月開始上大學。
statements.english: I'll be going to university starting in April.

statements.chinese: 今天雖然是愚人節,但你的惡作劇太過分了。說真的,我挺生氣的!
statements.english: Today may be April Fool's Day, but your prank went overboard. Seriously, I'm pretty angry!

statements.chinese: 齊里出生於三月或四月。
statements.english: Ziri was born in March or April.

statements.chinese: 今年四月,苔絲在教會集會上分享了她的經驗。
statements.english: Tessa shared her experience in a chapel assembly this April.

statements.chinese: 我知道湯姆可能不得不這麼做。
statements.english: I know Tom may have to do that.
They may go home by themselves.
May we be saved as soon as possible.
You may want to take a few steps back.

statements.chinese: 我們可以在這裡抽煙嗎?
statements.english: May we smoke here?

statements.chinese: 同一個符號,不同的人或不同的文化可能會有不同的解讀。
statements.english: The same sign may be interpreted differently by different people or different cultures.

statements.chinese: 湯姆可能會在下個月去澳洲。
statements.english: Tom may go to Australia next month.

statements.chinese: 自來水有可能含有氯、鉛等有害物質。
statements.english: There's a chance that tap water may contain harmful substances like chlorine and lead.

statements.chinese: 仔細搜尋敵人可能藏身的灌木叢。
statements.english: Investigate thoroughly the bushes where the enemy may be hiding.

statements.chinese: 這個故事聽起來可能很奇怪,但卻是千真萬確的。
statements.english: This story may sound strange, but it's absolutely true.

statements.chinese: 在阿爾及利亞,數千人正在競選 2021 年 6 月的立法選舉。
statements.english: In Algeria, thousands of people are running for the June 2021 legislative elections.

statements.chinese: 貝茨曾在 1984 年洛杉磯夏季奧運會上獲得三枚金牌,他是少數幾位能夠體會到像體操運動員西蒙拜爾斯 (她在日本奧運會上退出了一些比賽項目) 和網球名將大坂直美 (她在 6 月份退出了著名的溫布爾登網球錦標賽) 這樣的運動員所承受的壓力和情緒的精英運動員之一。
statements.english: Bates, who won three gold medals at the 1984 Summer Games in Los Angeles, is one of the few elite athletes who has some idea of the stress and emotions that run through athletes like gymnast Simone Biles, who withdrew from some Olympic events at the Games in Japan, and tennis ace Naomi Osaka, who left the prestigious Wimbledon tournament in June.

statements.chinese: 明年 6 月 22 日可以觀測到日全食。
statements.english: The total solar eclipse can be observed next year on June 22nd.
There were not many rainy days in June this year.

statements.chinese: 六月金龜子的幼蟲以植物根部為食。
statements.english: June beetle grubs feed on plant roots.

statements.chinese: 2018 年 6 月被捕的巴勒斯坦兒童被關押在奧弗監獄。
statements.english: The Palestinian children that were arrested in June 2018 are being held in the Ofer prison.

statements.chinese: 下一場音樂會將於六月舉行。
statements.english: The next concert will take place in June.

statements.chinese: 雅尼看到兒子在玩一隻金龜子。
statements.english: Yanni saw his son playing with a June beetle.

statements.chinese: 我寫下這段文字的時間是 2017 年 6 月 2 日 (星期五) 上午 10 點。
statements.english: I'm writing this on Friday, June 2, 2017 at 10 AM.
My daughter is getting married in June.

statements.chinese: 日本政府週一宣布,全球第三大經濟體在 7 月至 9 月的第三季以年率計算成長了 21%。
statements.english: Japan’s government announced Monday that the world’s third-largest economy grew at an annual pace of 21% in the third quarter spanning from July to September.

statements.chinese: 2004 年 7 月,薩米被判處 24 年有期徒刑。
statements.english: In July 2004, Sami was sentenced to 24 years in jail.

statements.chinese: 在所有童話故事裡出現的女巫中,沒有一個比沙女巫更討人喜歡、更善於交際了。這位女巫住在海邊堆積如山的沙子下面,夏天的時候,人們會在那裡用鏟子挖沙。她和其他女巫完全不同。她從不騎掃帚,也從不鑽煙囪。首先,海灘上根本沒有掃帚和煙囪;其次,就算有,她也不知道怎麼騎掃帚或鑽煙囪。沙女巫只會做一件事:遇到害怕的東西就鑽進沙裡;遇到不認識的人,就從沙子裡鑽出來。現在你知道沙女巫是什麼了吧。七歲的小詹克斯被曬得通紅,如果他知道你所知道的一切,那麼在七月一個炎熱的早晨,當他突然遭遇這場突如其來的災難時,他就能更好地應對了。
statements.english: Of all the witches that may be found in all the fairy tales ever told there is none more delightfully sociable than the Sand Witch. This Witch, who lives underneath the heaps of sand at the ocean's edge, where, in the summertime, you dig with your shovel, is not at all like other witches. She never rides on a broomstick, and she never goes down chimneys. In the first place there are no broomsticks or chimneys on the beach at the sea-shore, and in the second place she would not know how to ride on a broomstick or climb down a chimney, if there were. All the Sand Witch knows how to do is to sink into the sand when anything scares her, and to come up through the sand when she sees a chance to get acquainted with a person she never was acquainted with before. So now you know what a Sand Witch is. And if Junior Jenks, seven years old, and dreadfully sunburnt, had known what you know, he would have been much better prepared to face the one that came up right under his nose all of a sudden one hot July morning.

statements.chinese: 七月份,這條河不適合游泳。
statements.english: This river is dangerous to swim in, in July.

statements.chinese: 我們能否指出一種語言誕生的確切日期?你或許會這樣說:「真是個奇怪的問題!」然而,這樣的日期確實存在:7 月 26 日,世界語日。1887 年的這一天,路德維克萊澤柴門霍夫在華沙出版了一本關於「國際語言」的小冊子。
statements.english: Is it possible to indicate a date on which a language came into life? "What a question!" you will be inclined to say. And yet such a date exists: the 26th of July, the Day of Esperanto. On this day in 1887 appeared in Warsaw a booklet by Ludwik Lejzer Zamenhof about the "International Language".

statements.chinese: 在日本,梅雨季節從六月初持續到七月中旬。
statements.english: In Japan, the rainy season lasts from the beginning of June to the middle of July.

statements.chinese: 他就像七月四日的煙火一樣耀眼!我心想:「哇!」
statements.english: He was bright like the 4th of July! "Wow!", I thought!

statements.chinese: 當麗瑪開始誇獎齊里時,齊里就像七月的冰淇淋一樣融化了。
statements.english: Ziri was melting like ice cream in July when Rima started complimenting him.

statements.chinese: 今天是 2014 年 7 月 11 日。這是我第一次透過 Google 地圖「雲遊」希臘。這比我 2002 年親自去希臘旅行方便多了。最近,秘魯和哥倫比亞的一些城市也開始在 Google 地圖上進行精彩的虛擬導覽。我用的是 iPad mini 上的 iMaps+ 應用程式。
statements.english: It is now the 11th of July of 2014. It is my first time to vicariously travel Greece via Google Maps. It is really more convenient than my physical travel of Greece back in 2002. Recently, also some cities in Peru and Colombia have become open for fascinating virtual excursions on Google Maps. I use my iPad mini's iMaps+ app.
Happy 4th of July!

statements.chinese: 你聽過《阿爾卑斯山的少女海蒂》嗎?
statements.english: Have you heard of "Heidi, Girl of the Alps"?

statements.chinese: 這是阿爾卑斯山脈最高的山峰之一。
statements.english: It's among the highest mountains in the Alps.

statements.chinese: 阿爾卑斯山脈義大利一側的海拔通常較低。
statements.english: The Alps are generally lower on the Italian side.

statements.chinese: 你知道《阿爾卑斯山的少女海蒂》嗎?
statements.english: Do you know about "Heidi, Girl of the Alps"?

statements.chinese: 他在牆上鑽了個洞,把膨脹螺栓塞進去,擰上一顆螺絲,然後在螺絲上掛了一幅阿爾卑斯山的畫。
statements.english: He drilled a hole in the wall, pushed a Rawlplug into it, screwed in a screw, and hung on the screw a picture of the Alps.

statements.chinese: 我最喜歡的故事是《綠山牆的安妮》、《湯姆索亞歷險記》和《阿爾卑斯山的少女海蒂》。
statements.english: My favorite stories are "Anne of Green Gables", "The Adventures of Tom Sawyer" and "Heidi, Girl of the Alps".

statements.chinese: 德國阿爾卑斯山的樹線位於海拔約 1800 公尺處。
statements.english: The treeline in the German alps lies at an elevation of about 1800 meters.

statements.chinese: 阿爾卑斯山脈橫跨八個歐洲國家。
statements.english: The Alps extend across eight European countries.

statements.chinese: 我們想去阿爾卑斯山待兩週。
statements.english: We want to go to the Alps for a fortnight.

statements.chinese: 喜馬拉雅山脈比阿爾卑斯山脈高。
statements.english: The Himalayas are higher than the Alps.

statements.chinese: 明天,我將飛越雄偉的喜馬拉雅山脈。
statements.english: Tomorrow, I'll fly over the magnificent Himalayas.

statements.chinese: 喜馬拉雅山脈是位於亞洲大陸的山脈。
statements.english: The Himalayas are a mountain range located on the Asian continent.
I want to visit the Himalayas.

statements.chinese: 喜馬拉雅山脈被稱為亞洲的水塔,孕育了長江、恆河、印度河等 10 條主要河流。
statements.english: Known as the water towers of Asia, the Himalayas feed 10 major rivers such as the Yangtze, the Ganges and the Indus.

statements.chinese: 美國是一個可以用一個字來概括的國家。我曾與習近平主席一起在喜馬拉雅山麓。
statements.english: America is a nation that can be defined in a single word. I was in the foothills of the Himalayas with Xi Jinping.

statements.chinese: 如果我們在棋盤的第一個格子裡放一粒麥子,在第二個格子裡放兩粒麥子,在第三個格子裡放四粒麥子,以此類推,直到最後一個格子,那麼總共會有 18,446,744,073,709,551,615 粒麥子,足以堆成喜馬拉雅山的 100 倍高。
statements.english: If we were to put a grain of wheat on the first box of a chessboard, two grains on the second one, four on the third one and so on, until the last one, there would be 18,446,744,073,709,551,615 grains, enough to make a mountain 100 times taller than the Himalayas.

statements.chinese: 喜馬拉雅山脈的山峰比安地斯山脈的山峰更高。
statements.english: The mountains in the Himalayas are higher than those in the Andes.

statements.chinese: 我聽說他們在喜馬拉雅山脈發現了雪人的腳印。
statements.english: I heard that they found the footprints of an abominable snowman in the Himalayas.

statements.chinese: 「喜馬拉雅」的意思是「雪之居所」。
statements.english: "Himalaya" means "abode of snow".

statements.chinese: 我從火車車窗瞥見了富士山。
statements.english: I caught a glimpse of Mt. Fuji from the window of the train.

statements.chinese: 富士山可能是世界上最著名的山峰之一。
statements.english: Mt Fuji is probably one of the world's most famous mountains.
He climbed Mount Fuji four times.
Mt. Fuji is a symbol of Japan.

statements.chinese: 日本沒有哪座山比富士山更高。
statements.english: No mountain in Japan is higher than Mt. Fuji.
Have you ever climbed Mt Fuji?

statements.chinese: 他們放棄了攀登富士山的計畫。
statements.english: They gave up their plan to climb Mt. Fuji.
We want to climb Mt. Fuji.

statements.chinese: 他是第一個在冬季攀登富士山的人。
statements.english: He was the first man to climb Mt. Fuji in the winter.

statements.chinese: 現在是 2025 年 8 月 3 日,露露島。晚餐後,陽光下嫩綠的無花果,昨天醃製的甜醋,還有重新加熱的阿爾弗雷多義麵,我坐在陽台上,望著那棵針葉樹。樓下靜謐無聲,街道空無一車,一片悠閒。我的冰鎮青檸水在陽光下閃閃發光。最近,我常和那位法丹混血的 UFO 研究專家麥可聊天。我們談論內心深處的事情:智慧型裝置的迷醉,以及思維的衰退。他說,咖啡館已經不再是咖啡館了。人們忘記如何觀察、如何駐足停留。我跟他講起在日本的亞瑟,他會像僧侶凝視虛空一樣,對著空白的牆壁發呆。最近,我讓機器像詩人一樣說話,它們真的做到了。它們模仿伊莉莎白時代的詩歌,以及塔加洛語民謠中那古老而憂傷的韻律。我沿著通往蒂姆霍頓咖啡店的小路採摘黑莓。我像個孩子似的喊道:「莫拉!」我的朋友莫拉,她血液裡流著安地斯山脈的薄霧,她會笑的。今天,我買了黃檸檬。我本來想買青檸,但黃檸檬也可以。/ 黑莓的清晨 / 指尖殘留無花果的痕跡 / 街道依然沉睡
statements.english: It's Lulu Island, 3 August 2025. After supper—green figs tender with sunlight, sweet vinegar from yesterday’s pickled jar, and reheated Alfredo—I sat on the balcony and watched the conifer. Stillness below, a street without cars, without haste. My lime water, iced, caught the light. Michael, the Franco-Danish ufologist, has been in my conversations lately. We speak of inner things: the trance of smart devices, the mind’s eye dwindling. He says cafés aren’t cafés anymore. People forget how to look, how to linger. I tell him of Arthur in Japan—how he'd stare into blank walls like a monk gazing at emptiness. Lately I ask machines to speak like poets, and they do. They mimic Elizabethan verses and the old wistful lilt of Tagalog ballads. I pick blackberries along the path to Tim Hortons. "¡Moras!" I shout like a child. My friend Mora, whose blood flows with Andes mist, would smile. Today, I bought lemons. I meant limes, but lemons are all right. / blackberry morning— / a fig's ghost on my fingers / and the street still sleeps

statements.chinese: 帕查瑪瑪是安地斯山脈土著居民敬仰的大地和生育女神。
statements.english: Pachamama is a goddess of earth and fertility revered by the indigenous peoples of the Andes.

statements.chinese: 遊客攀登秘魯安地斯山脈的一座山峰,歷經兩個小時才到達山頂,他們氣喘吁吁。
statements.english: Tourists struggle for breath as they climb for two hours to reach the top of a mountain in the Peruvian Andes.

statements.chinese: 你憑什麼認為中東比安地斯山脈更重要?
statements.english: What makes you think the Middle East is more important than the Andes?

statements.chinese: 1910 年至 1980 年間,世界大部分地區都在變暖,而赤道以南安第斯山脈附近的一些地區實際上卻在變冷,之後直到 20 世紀 90 年代中期才發生了變化。
statements.english: As most of the world was warming up between 1910 and 1980, some areas south of the equator near the Andes were actually cooling down, and then afterwards had no change at all until the middle 1990s.

statements.chinese: 這是安第斯山脈的最高峰。
statements.english: It's the highest mountain in the Andes.

statements.chinese: 科學家稱,他們在南美洲安第斯山脈的雲霧森林中發現了一種新的食肉動物物種,這是 30 多年來的首次此類發現。
statements.english: Scientists say they have found a new species of carnivore in the cloud forests of the Andes mountains in South America — the first discovery of its kind in more than 30 years.

statements.chinese: 這群來自智利和秘魯安第斯山脈地區的音樂家自稱為「瓦伊諾」。他們演奏安地斯山脈的傳統音樂,使用古老的樂器,例如木笛、吉他和鈴鐺。各種各樣的音樂家、舞者和默劇演員經常在地鐵裡表演,靠著小費維持生計,同時也能繼續從事他們的藝術創作。
statements.english: This group of musicians from the Andes mountain region of Chile and Peru calls itself Wayno. They play the traditional music of the Andes, using age-old instruments like wooden flutes, guitars, and bells. A variety of musicians, dancers and mimes regularly perform in the subways, playing for tips that help them earn a living while practicing their art.

statements.chinese: 玛丽说今天在学校没有学新的东西。
statements.english: Mary said she didn't learn anything new at school today.

statements.chinese: 她又开始讲起了学校的秘密。
statements.english: She started talking about the school's secrets again.
Mike takes the bus to school.
Our teacher goes to school by car.

statements.chinese: 很多公立学校的食堂都很黑心。
statements.english: Many public school cafeterias are unscrupulous.

statements.chinese: 他的實驗室裡有所有最致命的毒。
statements.english: His laboratory contains all the deadliest poisons.

statements.chinese: 讓我們先談談在實驗室中做的實驗。
statements.english: Let's first talk about the experiments done in the laboratory.

statements.chinese: 一开始法医团队以为他们发现了人血,但后来才在实验室里发现这原来是牛血。
statements.english: At first, the forensic team thought they had found human blood, but later in the laboratory, they discovered it was actually cow blood.

statements.chinese: 昨天晚上,我快被实验室的蚊子咬死了。
statements.english: Last night, I was almost bitten to death by mosquitoes in the laboratory.

statements.chinese: 一连串的爆炸使实验室成为废墟。
statements.english: A series of explosions turned the laboratory into ruins.

statements.chinese: 这个实验室是我们每天工作的地方。
statements.english: This laboratory is where we work every day.
The air conditioning in the laboratory is broken.

statements.chinese: 小丁拿着一张照片问林老师:“您的这张照片是在北大图书馆照的吗?”
statements.english: Ding, holding a photo, asked Teacher Lin: "Was this photo of yours taken at the Peking University Library?"

statements.chinese: 咱们一起去图书馆学习,你觉得怎么样?
statements.english: How about we go to the library together to study?

statements.chinese: 我會將推薦的書目記在清單上,下次來圖書館時看。
statements.english: I will note down the recommended bibliography on the list and look for them next time I come to the library.
The post office is next to the library.

statements.chinese: 这个图书馆有超过50000册书。
statements.english: This library has more than 50,000 books.
How far is the library from here?

statements.chinese: 圖書館在公車站牌旁邊。
statements.english: The library is next to the bus stop.

statements.chinese: 今天我本打算在圖書館學習,但到12點左右才醒。
statements.english: Today I planned to study in the library, but I didn't wake up until around 12 o'clock.

statements.chinese: 一群年輕人在操場上打手球。
